gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Contemporary and clean, Noto Sans Cuneiform fills its lowercase with puffy, bead-like roundness and an e that stays open. Wallpoet stamps the heading above it, tall and bold, with thin gaps cutting through every letter.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Approachable from the first line, Noto Sans Deseret has a wide-looking lowercase with squat ascenders. Wallpoet's tall, stenciled commanding capitals above it make the pairing's strongest quality its stark difference in attitude.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Noto Sans Devanagari reads modern and compact, its capitals melting into the lowercase and its g leaving the lower curve open. Wallpoet would lose its stenciled gaps if it were made small, so give that heading room to stand big.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-duployan:
Contemporary and clean, this body font is easy to settle into.

Wallpoet grabs attention with a bold, stenciled, high-rising shout, while Noto Sans Duployan quietly handles the reading with its wide-mouthed a and oversized counters.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Neutral and modern in its large lowercase, Noto Sans Elbasan keeps its terminals open and its ascenders tucked close. Wallpoet's stenciled boldness feels loud beside it.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic is clean and modern, with open apertures throughout and ascenders that barely rise above the x-height. Wallpoet's stenciled heading would feel loud beside it; the body stays quiet.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic:
Professional and modern, Noto Sans Ethiopic is sturdy.

Wallpoet earns its keep when set big and short, where its bold, stenciled lines, with gaps between letters, can command attention without any help.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian is modern and clean, with open curves throughout and short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies. Wallpoet is built for bold announcements; this body is built for reading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Stencil-cut boldness meets approachable calm: Wallpoet leads with commanding, high-rising letters, while Noto Sans Glagolitic offers sturdy, open round forms underneath. They feel like a shout and a nod.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-gothic:
Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with stenciled gaps.

Noto Sans Gothic follows with big, open, bead-like counters and round forms like parentheses, giving the page a loud top and a professional, modern body.
